measured.proof: timed delegation runs, same prompt, two window sizes

pitfalls.symptom: every delegation ends with code 0 and writes nothing
pitfalls.remedy: size the window to the task, measure throughput before judging the model
pitfalls.proof: delegation log: empty outputs at 262144, full outputs at 65536

pitfalls.symptom: typographic quotes and invisible characters eaten or mangled in the returned code
pitfalls.remedy: send the instruction in a file with plain ASCII punctuation, never on the command line
pitfalls.proof: refused and replayed instructions in the guard log

pitfalls.symptom: the server answers with the model already loaded, whatever model the request names
pitfalls.remedy: read the model field of the RESPONSE, never trust the request
pitfalls.proof: request for model A answered by model B, response field shows B

pitfalls.symptom: the command line listing shows models that are not loaded
pitfalls.remedy: ask the server: GET /api/v0/models, state field
pitfalls.proof: listing and server state compared on the same machine

pitfalls.symptom: the response echoes the requested model name: nothing proves which model really answered
pitfalls.remedy: run a discriminating probe before a benchmark that depends on the model
pitfalls.proof: input token counts differ between two model names on the same prompt
